captureCountBasis: All story steps use two actual player views. Cargo has five initial steps, two complete five-step cargo cycles, and one recovery step; route has twenty steps and catchup seventeen. Existing references independently have 32/40/34 PNGs per viewport. Collection selects each journey once per viewport.
interpretation: Six confirmed pixel first failures at current unchanged executable source, no actual image inspection yet. Shared formation appearance is a hypothesis, not an approved cause. Full story execution is necessary to expose masked later behavior and pixels.
